name: Woodwork
description: Cabinets and furniture in sheet goods: carcass generator and cut list.

units.title: Units
units.description: Unit of the sizes below. The values shown at first are mm.

oneOf.title: In a groove
oneOf.description: In a groove 12 mm from the rear.

oneOf.title: Overlaid
oneOf.description: Fixed on the rear edges.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: Open back.

dividers.title: Dividers
dividers.description: Vertical dividers, splitting the inside into equal compartments.

shelves.title: Shelves
shelves.description: Shelves in each compartment, evenly spaced.

drawers.title: Drawers
drawers.description: A stack of equal drawers with overlay fronts, boxes sized for 12.7 mm slides. Shelves are then left out; not with doors or dividers.

plinth.title: Plinth height
plinth.description: 0 for none. The plinth board sits 50 mm back from the front.

shelf_pins.title: Shelf pin holes
shelf_pins.description: 32 mm system: rows of 5 mm holes 37 mm from the front and back. The shelves rest on them.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Overlay doors with 35 mm hinge cup holes and 2 mm gaps: 0, 1, 2, or one per compartment (dividers + 1).

handles.title: Handle holes
handles.description: 5 mm screw holes through the doors, on the opening side, and the drawer fronts.

oneOf.title: Knob
oneOf.description: One hole.

oneOf.title: Pull
oneOf.description: Two holes, 128 mm apart.

handle_position.title: Handle position
handle_position.description: Where on a door the handle holes go. On a drawer front Auto is the middle.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Top on a floor unit, bottom on a wall unit, middle on a door over 1200 mm.

oneOf.title: Top
oneOf.description: 100 mm from the top.

oneOf.title: Bottom
oneOf.description: 100 mm from the bottom.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Writes each board's name on it, the name the cut list has.

match.title: Match selected
match.description: Link height, depth, panel thickness and plinth to the selected cabinet instead of reading them here.

oneOf.title: Selected cabinet
oneOf.description: Select any part of it first. Resize that cabinet later and this one follows.

material.title: Material
material.description: Board material of every panel. Change it later with Material.

place.title: Place
place.description: Right, left and above go against the selected cabinet: select any part of it first.

oneOf.title: Right of selected
oneOf.description: Against its right side, backs flush. On a corner cabinet's return it is turned to continue the return.

oneOf.title: Left of selected
oneOf.description: Against its left side, backs flush.

oneOf.title: Above selected
oneOf.description: On top of it, backs flush.

name.title: Name
name.description: Prefix for the panel names. A name that is taken gets the next free number: Cabinet, Cabinet 2, Cabinet 3.

units.title: Units
units.description: Unit of the sizes below. The values shown at first are mm.

corner.title: Corner
corner.description: Which corner of the room the cabinet is for.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Right when placed right of the selected cabinet, else left.

oneOf.title: Left
oneOf.description: The corner is at the back left, and the return runs forward along the left wall.

oneOf.title: Right
oneOf.description: The mirror image.
Two fronts at a right angle, with a bi-fold pair of doors.

oneOf.title: Diagonal
oneOf.description: One front straight across the open corner at 45 degrees, with one door.

width.title: Width
width.description: Along the back wall, from the corner.

return.title: Return
return.description: Along the side wall, from the corner.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Depth of both legs, wall to front. diagonal: the depth at the end of the width; at the end of the return it is width - return + depth, so the same when width and return are equal.

plinth.title: Plinth height
plinth.description: 0 for none. The plinth sits 50 mm back from the fronts.

shelf_pins.title: Shelf pin holes
shelf_pins.description: 32 mm system: rows of 5 mm holes in both ends and both backs. The shelves rest on them.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Overlay doors with 35 mm hinge cup holes. L-shaped: a bi-fold pair, the second door hinged to the first. Diagonal: one door.

oneOf.title: Hinged left
oneOf.description: Hinged at the cabinet's left end, as you face the corner.

oneOf.title: Hinged right
oneOf.description: Hinged at its right end.

handles.title: Handle holes
handles.description: 5 mm screw holes. L-shaped: through the door that folds, beside the fold. Diagonal: on the door's opening edge.

oneOf.title: Knob
oneOf.description: One hole.

oneOf.title: Pull
oneOf.description: Two holes, 128 mm apart.

handle_position.title: Handle position
handle_position.description: Where on a door the handle holes go.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: Top on a floor unit, bottom on a wall unit, middle on a door over 1200 mm.

oneOf.title: Top
oneOf.description: 100 mm from the top.

oneOf.title: Bottom
oneOf.description: 100 mm from the bottom.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Writes each board's name on it, the name the cut list has.

match.title: Match selected
match.description: Link height, depth, panel thickness and plinth to the selected cabinet instead of reading them here.

oneOf.title: Selected cabinet
oneOf.description: Select any part of it first. Resize that cabinet later and this one follows.

material.title: Material
material.description: Board material of every panel. Change it later with Material.

place.title: Place
place.description: Right, left and above go against the selected cabinet: select any part of it first.

oneOf.title: Right of selected
oneOf.description: Against its right side, backs flush. On a corner cabinet's return it is turned to continue the return.

oneOf.title: Left of selected
oneOf.description: Against its left side, backs flush.

oneOf.title: Above selected
oneOf.description: On top of it, backs flush.

name.title: Name
name.description: Prefix for the panel names. A name that is taken gets the next free number: Corner, Corner 2.

dividers.title: Dividers
dividers.description: Empty: as it is. Box cabinet only.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Empty: as it is. Box cabinet only: 0, 1, 2, or one per compartment.

drawers.title: Drawers
drawers.description: Empty: as it is. Box cabinet only.

shelf_pins.title: Shelf pin holes
shelf_pins.description: Rows of 5 mm holes for the shelves.

handle_position.title: Handle position
handle_position.description: Where on a door the handle goes.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Each board's name written on it.

plinth.title: Plinth height
plinth.description: Empty: as it is. In the unit the cabinet was made in; 0 for none.

type.title: Type
type.description: Drills where the sides meet the bottom and top of the cabinet you selected a part of.

oneOf.title: Confirmat screws
oneOf.description: 7 mm through the side and a 5 mm pilot, for 7 x 50 screws.

oneOf.title: Dowels
oneOf.description: 8 mm holes for 8 x 35 dowels.

oneOf.title: Whole cabinet
oneOf.description: Every panel of the cabinet you selected a part of.

oneOf.title: Selected parts
oneOf.description: Only the selected parts, such as the doors.

file.title: Save as
file.description: A file name such as kitchen.csv: also saves the list as CSV in the folder for cut lists you approved when installing. Empty: only show it.
